28.6.10.3 regex_search [re.alg.search]
🔗
template<class BidirectionalIterator, class Allocator, class charT, class traits>
  bool regex_search(BidirectionalIterator first, BidirectionalIterator last,
                    match_results<BidirectionalIterator, Allocator>& m,
                    const basic_regex<charT, traits>& e,
                    regex_constants::match_flag_type flags = regex_constants::match_default);
1
#
Preconditions: BidirectionalIterator models
bidirectional_iterator ([iterator.concept.bidir]).
2
#
Effects: Determines whether there is some sub-sequence within [first, last) that matches
the regular expression e.
 The parameter flags is used to control how the
expression is matched against the character sequence.
 Returns true if such a sequence
exists, false otherwise.
3
#
Postconditions: m.ready() == true in all cases.
 If the function returns false, then the effect
on parameter m is unspecified except that m.size()
returns 0 and m.empty() returns true.
 Otherwise
the effects on parameter m are given in Table 124.
